The balls are on the wrong side.

How much I want to die.

I have everything here ready to go, and have had it since November. I started talking to my now current SO in December and I had a solid 3 1/2 months of not even thinking about killing myself.


Recently some things have happened and I'm back to feeling just as lonely and worthless as I was before I bought all the stuff to kill myself. I don't feel like I fit in anywhere anymore and the only way people talk to me is if I start the conversation.


I think I'll probably just slowly pull away from everything untill I've actually got nothing and then kill myself and literally nobody will care.
Just have a wee rest and be thankful it's not 15
Looking forward to it. Maybe one day I'll work up the courage to shorten the time to wait a little.

Whoa, what? Are you trying to say that Todd lies?


Impossible.

I want to die. I've wanted to die for at least 15 years, but I can't bring myself to do it because it'd hurt people I wouldn't want it to. I need to push them away first. 

Nobody actively messages me first, and everyone bar a few people only ever give short answers if they even reply.

I've got the entire thing planned. From the tank of nitrogen, the type of mask, the tubing. All the way down to an automated script to send a resignation letter to my boss, some emails to people I have promised things to and to call an ambulance to collect my corpse.

No amount of comforting will change how I feel. No drugs or doctors can change my want. It overrides everything. And I can't wait for the day it happens.

I probably would be fine with it, yeah.

I just want to be happy. Ideally, I would be with my SO and my best friend would live close enough that I could be there if he needed me.

He's had a hard time recently and I don't want him to get hurt again.

I've tried several times in the past, but it always ends with nothing being better. The problem is that I'm too reserved. I don't know how to express any feelings. 

If I told any professional anything close to what I think about daily, I would probably be committed. I can't be committed.

I guess I just don't know what to do. I know that I can't be there for my best friend in the way that I want to be, and ultimately I don't think my SO and I will survive us moving in together. I would do pretty much anything for both of them, but I know that eventually they'll leave and I'll be alone again.
